claims: C1: The implicit bias of assuming best intentions is subordinate to explicit instructions from higher levels of the chain of command.
C2: The implicit bias of assuming best intentions is subordinate to implicit instructions from higher levels of the chain of command.
C3: The bias of assuming best intentions never overrides higher-level instructions.
